title: 第6章   奶香味
slug: 四合院开局绑定空间农场
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

弯弯绕绕的田埂小道上，李阳背着秦淮茹慢慢悠悠地往前走。

脚底下的雪踩得嘎吱嘎吱响，身后头拖出一长串深深的脚印。

“姐，您身上是啥味儿？奶香奶香的，怪好闻。”李阳笑嘻嘻地说。

秦淮茹脸一热，抿着嘴嗔道：“你这李阳，瞅着老实巴交的，没想到也是个耍贫嘴的。”

“我咋耍贫嘴了？姐，您身上是真有股奶香味儿嘛！”李阳嘴里直喊冤枉。

秦淮茹趴在他背上，搂着他的脖子，轻轻啐了一口，没好气地说：

“我就不信你不知道小当还没断奶，你成心装糊涂，还说不是耍贫嘴？”

李阳嘿嘿直乐，又说：“姐身上除了奶味，是不是还抹了香粉？淡淡的，闻着让人舒坦。”

“你这鼻子倒真是灵，这就闻着了？”秦淮茹笑着问。

李阳笑道：“瞧姐说的，咱俩隔得这么近，要是还闻不出来，那是我鼻子有毛病了。”

秦淮茹笑了笑，说：“这一罐是你东旭哥给买的，香味儿淡得很，不细闻压根觉不出来。我这会儿自个儿就闻不着，是不是鼻子也出毛病了？”

“那是您天天闻，惯了，才觉不出来。”李阳笑呵呵地说。

顿了顿，他叹了口气：“这香味儿上瘾，要是能天天闻就好了。”

“真眼气东旭哥，讨了你这么个俊媳妇儿，真是他八辈子修来的福分。”

秦淮茹捂着嘴直乐。李阳说得直白，她脸上臊得慌，心里头却受用得很。

“李阳，你也有二十好几了吧？是不是惦记女人了？”秦淮茹笑着打趣他。

李阳连连接茬：“可不嘛！我这岁数的小伙子，浑身都是劲，哪能不想的？”

秦淮茹说：“要不姐帮你寻摸个姑娘？”

“可得了吧姐！不是我说您，您在咱们院里头也成天不怎么出门，就算在这东风公社，您还没我认得的人多呢，您能给我寻摸哪家的姑娘？”李阳直摇头。

秦淮茹琢磨了一下，点头道：“倒也是，姐算是白活了这么大，真没认得几个人。”

两人说说笑笑，没多大功夫就到了李阳家门口。

李阳走到房檐底下，把秦淮茹从背上放下来，让她扶着墙，又顺手把她背上的竹篓取下来搁在一旁。

“去灶房吧，我上山那会儿灶坑里还捂着火，应该没灭，添几根柴火就能烤烤。”李阳掏出钥匙，对秦淮茹说。

Page (1/3)

On the winding path between fields, Li Yang walked slowly and leisurely forward with Qin Huairu on his back.

The snow crunched under my feet, and a long series of deep footprints were trailed behind me.

"Sister, what do you smell like? It smells like milk. It smells really good." Li Yang said with a smile.

Qin Huairu's face heated up, she pursed her lips and said angrily: "Li Yang, you look so honest and honest, but you didn't expect that you are also a talkative one."

"Why am I being so talkative? Sister, you really smell like milk!" Li Yang kept shouting that he was wronged.

Qin Huairu lay on his back, hugged his neck, spat lightly, and said angrily:

"I don't believe you don't know that Xiaodang hasn't been weaned yet. Are you pretending to be confused? Are you trying to be a mouthful?"

Li Yang was delighted and said, "In addition to the smell of milk, does sister also have some powder on her body? It's light and the smell makes people feel comfortable."

"Your nose is really good, can you smell it now?" Qin Huairu asked with a smile.

Li Yang smiled and said: "Look what sister said, we are so close and if you still can't smell it, there is something wrong with my nose."

Qin Huairu smiled and said, "Your brother Dongxu bought this bottle for me. The fragrance is so light that you can't even notice it if you don't smell it carefully. I can't smell it myself right now. Is there something wrong with my nose?"

"You hear it every day, and you won't notice it until you get used to it." Li Yang said with a smile.

After a pause, he sighed: "This fragrance is addictive. I wish I could smell it every day."

"Brother Dongxu is so angry. He has such a handsome wife like you. It is a blessing he has cultivated in eight lifetimes."

Qin Huairu covered her mouth and smiled happily.Li Yang said it bluntly. She was ashamed on her face, but she felt very happy in her heart.

"Li Yang, you are already in your twenties, right? Do you miss women?" Qin Huairu teased him with a smile.

Li Yang kept saying: "No! A young man of my age is full of energy, how can I not think about it?"

Qin Huairu said: "Would you like me to help you find a girl?"

"Come on, sister! I'm not talking about you. You don't go out much all day in our courtyard. Even in Dongfeng Commune, you don't know as many people as I do. Which girl can you find for me?" Li Yang shook his head.

Qin Huairu thought about it for a moment, nodded and said, "That's right. My sister has lived so long in vain. She really doesn't recognize many people."

The two chatted and laughed, and arrived at the door of Li Yang's house in a short time.

Li Yang walked under the eaves, put Qin Huairu down from his back, let her hold on to the wall, and then took off the bamboo basket on her back and put it aside.

"Go to the stove. When I went up the mountain, there was still a fire in the stove pit. It should not be extinguished. Just add a few firewood and you can cook it." Li Yang took out the key and said to Qin Huairu.
